definitions.gloss: show-off; vain person; someone who puts on airs
definitions.explanation: A person who tries to appear better, richer, or more capable than they actually are. Also used as an adjective to describe such behavior.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りだ。
{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな{性格|せいかく}のせいで{借金|しゃっきん}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: Due to a vain personality, debts piled up.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りで、{無理|むり}してブランド{品|ひん}ばかり{買|か}っている。
examples.english: He's vain and keeps buying brand-name goods beyond his means.

notes:
Derived from {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る (to put on airs, to show off) with the suffix っぱり turning the verb phrase into a noun describing a person with that trait. Carries a mildly negative connotation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな{人|ひと}: a vain person
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りな{性格|せいかく}: a show-off personality
- {見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}りで{損|そん}をする: to lose out by putting on airs

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}る: to put on airs, to show off — the verb phrase this word derives from
- {見栄|みえ}: vanity, show, appearances — the base noun

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自慢|じまん}したがり: someone who likes to brag — focuses on verbal boasting
- ナルシスト: narcissist — focuses on self-admiration rather than impressing others
- {格好|かっこう}つけ: someone who tries to look cool — focuses on appearance and behavior
